{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "ismaelsadeeq",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Approach ACK, but contested keeping the estimator refactor and requested explicit block_policy failure testing"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5793157228",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "recomputing weight in the estimator leaves the same witness-mismatch false positive unaddressed in block policy, whereas filtering in removeForBlock could cleanly fix both",
      "quote": "Rather than recomputing weight from the connected block, I think there's a cleaner fix that covers both",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the stack to require exact wtxid matching in removeForBlock as requested",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5802096604",
        "c:5823154747"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5823154747",
      "status_by_quote": "Updated the stack to calculate coverage from mined transaction weights in one block walk, then require an exact wtxid match"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5828369388",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "drop the mempool estimator refactor and changes, as fixing the false positive in removeForBlock naturally works for both fee estimators",
      "quote": "This should be simplified, we do not need the refactor and the changes in the mempool estimator at all.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "reviewer pushed back that the refactor is out of scope and belongs in its own PR; author squashed and maintained preference to keep it",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5843201371",
        "c:5877422519"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5866418919",
      "status_by_quote": "Not sure I agree, so I think that's a refactor that is beyond the scope of this fix, hence should be separate from this fix and be in it's own PR."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5828369388",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add a test indicating the effects of the fix for block_policy, explicitly recording failure on witness mismatch",
      "quote": "We should also have a test that indicates the effects of the fix for `block_policy` as well.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author extended remove_for_block_witness_mismatch to verify failure recording for missed targets as requested",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5843201371",
        "c:5877422519"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5877422519",
      "status_by_quote": "I've extended `remove_for_block_witness_mismatch` to verify that witness mismatches produce no false confirmation and record failures for missed targets."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5793157228",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "an inherent false positive in master causes weight miscounts when witness variants differ and should be fixed",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "removeForBlock",
        "block_policy",
        "mempool_policy",
        "processBlockTx"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5828369388",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",
      "reason": "fixing the false positive in removeForBlock naturally works for both fee rate estimators",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "removeForBlock",
        "mempool estimator"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "ismaelsadeeq to re-review after the test extension and response on keeping the estimator refactor",
      "id": "c:5877422519"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Updated with ismaelsadeeq's pushback on the estimator refactor (marking that suggestion contested) and clarification on testing block_policy failure recording, which l0rinc implemented in remove_for_block_witness_mismatch."
}
